title: First-Run Flow: Modular Checklist Toolkits and Contextual Tips
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Design a modular first-run checklist and contextual tooltip system for the Redwood Console that adapts to account state (new org, existing org with models, demo workspace). Deliver visual assets (PNG/SVG), microcopy variants, annotated screenshots for engineering, and a lightweight prototype. Focus on: modular checklist cards that can be reordered and collapsed; tip banners that surface only when a feature is relevant; graceful empty states for Models, Endpoints, and Billing; accessibility and localization-ready text; instrumentation events for analytics.
tasks: Audit current onboarding touchpoints across Console (tour modals, empty states, checklist panel)
Create card system components in Figma: compact, expanded, completed, blocked
Design 3 empty-state illustrations (Models / Endpoints / Billing) with 2 color palettes (light/dark)
Write microcopy matrix: primary CTA, secondary CTA, microtip, tooltip help for each card
Produce annotated screenshots for engineering and a simple clickable prototype (Figma)
Record accessibility review checklist (contrast, keyboard nav, aria labels)
Handoff assets and variant tokens to frontend (SVGs + token mapping)
acceptance_criteria: Figma master components for compact/expanded/completed/blocked checklist cards exist and are tokenized
Three empty-state illustrations exported in light + dark themes as optimized SVGs
Microcopy matrix finalized and approved by PM and Legal for localization
Prototype demonstrates flow for new-org, existing-org-with-models, and demo-workspace variants
Engineering has annotated screenshots + a handoff package including asset names and intended animation specs
Accessibility checklist passed (WCAG AA contrast, keyboard navigable, aria labels mapped to each interactive element)
Event taxonomy documented for analytics (events: onboarding_card_shown, onboarding_card_completed, tip_dismissed, empty_state_cta_clicked)

decisions: Use modular card architecture so PMs can reorder or hide steps without new design work
Provide two illustration colorways (light/dark) and a neutral outline-only SVG for low-bandwidth contexts
Toast-style contextual tips will auto-hide after 20s and have manual dismiss; dismissed tips will not reappear for 30 days (configurable by backend)
Animations will be limited to subtle transforms (fade + translate) to preserve perceived performance; complex sequences will use Lottie with static fallback
next_steps: Finalize microcopy variants and hand to localization team (target: 2026-03-04)
Export final SVGs + Lottie specs and upload to shared drive (target: 2026-03-05)
Engineering to implement checklist panel with feature-flag gating for canary (ENG-20988)
Schedule an internal UX demo with Growth and Support to validate CTAs (target: 2026-03-07)
notes_for_engineering: Provide token names for color/spacing used in components: token-color-primary, token-bg-muted, token-gap-16
Checklist cards need 3 states exposed via data-state attribute: compact | expanded | completed
Analytics events: onboarding_card_shown (card_id, org_id, user_id_safe_hash), onboarding_card_completed (card_id), tip_dismissed (tip_id)
Fallback plan: if SVG animation not supported, show static SVG with CSS transition only
